        ps.ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
),
candidate_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_acctbal,
        s.s_name,
        n.n_name,
        ps.ps_partkey,
        p.p_mfgr,
        s.s_address,
        s.s_phone,
        s.s_comment
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
      AND p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
      AND ps.ps_supplycost = (
          SELECT mc.min_cost
          FROM min_costs mc
          WHERE mc.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey

  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
  lineitem l
JOIN
  part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey

  l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG')

    (p.p_brand = 'Brand#34'
     AND p.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')
     AND l.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30)
  )

SELECT
  c.c_name,
  c.c_custkey,
  o.o_orderkey,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_totalprice,
  SUM(l.l_quantity) AS sum_quantity
FROM
  customer c
JOIN
  orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN
  lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY
  c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice
HAVING
  SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY
  SUM(l.l_quantity) DESC, o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate <= '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT 
    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_receiptdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate < '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

SELECT
            s.s_name,
            COUNT(*) AS numwait
        FROM supplier s
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
        JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
        WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
          AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
          AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
          AND l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
          AND (
              EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM lineitem l2
                  WHERE l2.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
                  AND l2.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey
              )
              AND
              NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM lineitem l2
                  WHERE l2.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
                  AND l2.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey
                  AND l2.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
              )
          )
        GROUP BY s.s_name
        ORDER BY numwait DESC, s.s_name
        LIMIT 100

```sql
WITH filtered_partsupp AS (
    SELECT
        s.acctbal,
        s.name,
        n.name,
        p.p_partkey,
        p.p_mfgr,
        s.address,
        s.phone,
        s.comment,
        ps.ps_partkey,
        ps.ps_supplycost
    FROM part p
    JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
      AND p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
),
min_cost AS (
    SELECT
        ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM filtered_partsupp
    GROUP BY ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s_acctbal,
    s_name,
    n_name,
    p_partkey,
    p_mfgr,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    s_comment
FROM filtered_partsupp
JOIN min_cost ON filtered_partsupp.ps_partkey = min_cost.ps_partkey
WHERE filtered_partsupp.ps_supplycost = min_cost.min_cost
ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name ASC, s_name ASC, p_partkey ASC
LIMIT 100
```
